source: CORRECTED 2026-10-02. Walk-forward OOS 2021-01 to 2026-07, 8 crypto coins, hybrid lattice (slack 4), ATR24, pessimistic fills (3bp through), maker 2bp / taker 5bp, 1x size, grid features lagged one bar (causal). The earlier version of this sheet (2.40x, Sharpe 3.7, EV +0.265R) used same-bar ATR/trend/z features, which is lookahead, and is withdrawn.
caveats: Lookahead bug found 2026-10-02 and fixed in the backtest; earlier published numbers are withdrawn.
Causal neighborhood sweep (k, ATR window, Donchian, z-gate, stop, hedge, slack, ladder/static) found no config with positive EV and drawdown below 5%.
Backtest fill path (O-L-H-C vs O-H-L-C) is chosen by the bar's close, a small residual leak that may still flatter results slightly.
Survivor coins; no queue-position or adverse-selection model; 3bp penetration haircut is arbitrary.
